DoorKind.description: How a link between maps is crossed: a door, or stairs, a ladder or a lift between floors.
DoorKind.title: DoorKind

MapTile.description: A tile on a given map: the village or an interior, or in side view a street or a floor.
MapTile.title: MapTile

description:
A link between two maps: taking it from either tile puts you on the other one. A door joins
the village or a street (`outside`) and a building's ground floor (`inside`). Stairs, a ladder
or a lift join two floors' maps, `outside` the lower and `inside` the upper.

kind.description: How it's crossed. Left out for a door.

outside.description: The walkable tile in front of the building's door, or the lower floor's end.

inside.description: The mat just inside the interior's entrance, or the upper floor's end.
